description: Get the full public profile of a single XRPL domain — owner, NFT token ID, metadata, avatar, fullname, description, social handles, linked chain addresses, and optionally the on-chain ownership history (pass include_history=true). Use when the user asks "show me X.xrp", "what does X.xrp link to?", "who owns X.xrp?", or "show me the history of X.xrp". Returns null fields gracefully if no profile is set.

include_history.description: Include the on-chain ownership timeline (transfers, marketplace sales).

name: get_domain_profile
